name: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Demonstrate the parameter-shift rule in Penny
task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Demonstrate the parameter-shift rule in PennyLane: define a QNode <Z> = f(RY(theta)) and verify qml.grad matches the manual shift formula (f(t+pi/2)-f(t-pi/2))/2 at theta=1.888. Provide a complete, self-contained program that runs as-is and prints its results.
